name: Ambush
rules: Your next attack this turn deals +3 damage.
quip: I was hoping you’d come around.

name: Disarm
rules: Choose one player. They discard their highest-damage weapon.
quip: You had a handle on this. Had.

name: Steal
rules: Choose one player. Pick 1 card from their hand and take it.

name: Search
rules: Draw 3 cards. Keep 1 and discard the rest.
quip: One of these has to be useful.

name: Reload
rules: Keep your next weapon played this turn instead of discarding it after use.
quip: I wasn’t finished making my point.

name: Sabotage
rules: Choose one player. They discard 2 cards of their choice, or their whole hand if fewer.

name: Mark Target
rules: Choose one player. Attacks against them deal +1 damage until the round ends.

name: Intimidate
rules: Choose one player. Until your next turn, they must discard 1 other card before a single-target weapon attack against you. Pay once for SMG. Minigun is exempt.
quip: A little fear goes a long way.

name: Adrenaline
rules: Gain 1 net action this turn, then lose 2 health.
